START_HERE.col_1: Builder-ready synthetic environment for the Industrial Metaverse demonstrator.
30 assets · 20,160 raw telemetry records · 1,000 events · 300 historical work orders · 38 RAG docs.
3D object → asset identity → current condition → evidence → documentation → explainable AI → safe verification / maintenance workflow.
Not received yet. Scene_Anchors is deliberately a replaceable mapping layer; only scene paths/coordinates need remapping when the splat arrives.
Designed for web, Unreal, Unity, OpenUSD/Omniverse or other suitable 3D stacks.
Explicit source IDs, confidence, data quality and mapping confidence let teams distinguish evidence from hypotheses.
Everything is synthetic; no real customer geometry/process data, confidential thresholds or autonomous field-control instructions.
telemetry_full_14d_30min.csv contains the full telemetry corpus; Excel includes a recent 3-day sample for easy inspection.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Control valve diagnostic context
Knowledge_Docs.content: Use position, controller diagnostics, pneumatic condition, process context and service history together. Treat friction/stiction, position deviation, abnormal load, supply pressure and device alerts as investigation signals, not standalone proof.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Process pump condition context
Knowledge_Docs.content: Use vibration, bearing temperature, pressure, flow and motor load together. Look for consistent multivariate changes and verify locally before maintenance work.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Electric motor condition context
Knowledge_Docs.content: Use vibration, bearing temperature, current/load and operating history. Prefer trend evidence over isolated thresholds.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Pressure transmitter validation
Knowledge_Docs.content: Assess continuity, drift, signal quality and comparison against process context or a reference measurement.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Vibration sensor quality context
Knowledge_Docs.content: Assess signal stability, drift, missing data and mounting quality. Poor sensor quality should reduce downstream confidence.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Field-service safety guardrail
Knowledge_Docs.content: The assistant must not replace site procedures, lockout/tagout, permits, OEM instructions or qualified personnel. Recommend verification and escalation rather than autonomous physical action.

Knowledge_Docs.title: Evidence-grounded AI response contract
Knowledge_Docs.content: Name the asset, cite telemetry/events/doc IDs, state confidence, distinguish observation from hypothesis, and propose the next safe verification step.

Knowledge_Docs.title: 3D scene-to-asset mapping contract
Knowledge_Docs.content: Map visible objects to stable asset IDs with explicit confidence. Mapping may use scene hierarchy, annotation, QR/NFC or computer vision. Never silently guess identity.

Builder_Questions.builder_question: Identify a device in 3D and show its current state, recent evidence and documents.
Detect emerging degradation from multivariate time-series patterns.
Explain every diagnosis with exact evidence IDs and confidence.
Prioritize work using condition, criticality and uncertainty.
Support 3D object → evidence → service case → work-order draft on mobile/tablet.
Reduce confidence when sensor or mapping quality is poor.
Replace synthetic feeds with OPC UA/MQTT/API sources without redesigning the product.
Upgrade scene mapping to CV/VLM recognition while preserving identity confidence.
Remain portable across web, OpenUSD/Omniverse, Unity and Unreal.
Package evidence for remote expert collaboration.

Change_Log.change: Built research-informed synthetic industrial-metaverse pack with replaceable 3D mapping layer, correlated device telemetry, events, history, RAG corpus and trustworthy-AI metadata.
Raw telemetry separated as machine-readable CSV while recent 3-day sample remains in Excel for usability.
No real Valmet customer data or autonomous maintenance-control instructions included.
